title: buffframe
summary: BuffFrame now uses a non-overlapping 45px vertical grid, a padding-free 290x150 owner, right-button release ownership, owner-GUID/session continuity with appearance-stamped duration joins, and draw-derived element telemetry. Its 205px right inset, 35px horizontal step, compact timer, stack and tooltip presentation, fallback/filter/capacity laws, pulse/colors, and wire contract remain MSUI's protected behavior. Status remains implemented/unverified until the listed connected-client gates are captured.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI preserves insertion order, reconciles descriptor changes and duration packets, repacks removals, filters hidden auras, and enforces the 16-buff/8-debuff bounds.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI joins slot-keyed duration packets to the live spell, computes remaining time every frame, leaves permanent auras untimed, and applies the shared 31-second 0.75-second pulse law.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI renders the required icon, conditional stack count, exact debuff overlay UVs, and Spell.dbc-backed dispel-class tinting.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. The shared player-aura input surface presents live spell, stack, description, duration, and cancellation guidance and removes it when hover ends.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. Right-click cancellation is guarded by the descriptor cancelable bit and sends the exact build-5875 CMSG_CANCEL_AURA spell-id body.

MSUI diverges from Benilla — decide: port Benilla behavior, or record a decision preserving MSUI (only allowed if UI/graphics). Both clients have complete aura-bar presentation; MSUI's established anchor, 35-pixel row spacing, compact timer style, tooltip placement, and stack typography are preserved because they are present differences, not gaps.
openItems.resolution: Nico's 2026-08-23 no-touch ruling preserves the established MSUI Buff Frame presentation under decision 0007; aura state and behavior remain must-match.
